source_refs.title: Use Made for iPhone hearing devices - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Pair and connect your hearing device: iPhone or iPad
source_refs.applicability: Made for iPhone (MFi) hearing devices on iPhone or iPad; the page gives no iOS version number
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Tap Pair MFi Hearing Device, then follow the onscreen instructions.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Make sure that iOS or iPadOS is up to date. 2. Open the Settings app. 3. Tap Accessibility, then tap Hearing Devices. 4. Tap Pair MFi Hearing Device, then follow the onscreen instructions. You'll be asked to select your available hearing device, then tap Pair. If you don't see Pair MFi Hearing Device, tap the name of your hearing device when it appears in Hearing Devices settings. Then tap Pair when you see one or more Bluetooth pairing requests.

source_refs.title: Find & set up Bluetooth devices near your Android device - Android Help
source_refs.applicability: General Bluetooth accessories on Android; some steps work only on Android 15 and up; the page does not say which steps
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: 1. From the top of the screen, swipe down. 2. Touch and hold Bluetooth. 3. Tap Pair new device. If there's no Pair new device, check under Available devices or tap More, then Refresh. 4. To pair your device, tap the name of the Bluetooth device. 5. Follow the on-screen instructions. If you're asked for a passcode and don't have it, try the most common ones like 0000 or 1234. Some of these steps work only on Android 15 and up.
